# telnyx_custom_storage_credential (Resource)

Credentials for storing call recordings of a connection in your own AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage or Azure bucket.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (String) One of `azure`, `gcs`, `s3`, `s3-generic`.
- `configuration` (String, Sensitive) A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `connection_id` (String) The connection id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_custom_storage_credential.example <connection_id>
```
